commands: echo CALL_STATE; adb shell dumpsys telephony.registry | grep -E 'mCallState=' | head -n 4; APK=$(adb shell pm path pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge | head -n1 | sed 's/^package://'); echo INVENTORY; adb shell "CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.ShellAudioProbe inventory"; echo OFFCALL_CAPTURE; adb shell "CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.ShellAudioProbe capture-downlink 1000"
